mapper.select: SELECT SUM(wrd.receive_qty) receive_qty FROM warehouse_receive_detail wrd LEFT JOIN warehouse_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wrd.is_deleted = FALSE AND wr.purchase_order_id = #{PurchaseOrderId} AND wrd.skuId = #{skuId}

SELECT wr.id, wr.code, wr.supplier_name, wr.approve_status, wrd.sku_no, wr.bill_date, wrd.receive_qty, wrd.exceed_qty, wr.delivery_warehouse_name, wr.receive_user_name, wr.purchase_user_name, wrd.remark, wrd.purchase_order_detail_id FROM warehouse_receive_detail wrd LEFT JOIN warehouse_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wrd.is_deleted = FALSE AND wr.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

SELECT wr.id, wr.purchase_order_id, wr.purchase_order_code, wr.supplier_name, wrd.sku_id, wrd.sku_no, wr.delivery_warehouse_name, wrd.purchase_order_detail_id FROM warehouse_receive_detail wrd LEFT JOIN warehouse_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wrd.is_deleted = FALSE AND wr.id = #{id}
